title: console: an app's reports have no index — a report the app's navigation does not name has no UI path, and ⌘K finds only the reports the navigation names
body:
**Filing gate ①:** a measured, user-visible gap with named locations. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`os-project-manager`, session `session_01BDgipbNowaGa139em8Fhoq`) on the maintainer's direct instruction in that session's chat. Asked "7 of HotCRM's 10 reports have no entry point: how to handle it", the seat offered A (HotCRM lists every report in its own navigation) and C (the console gets a report index). The maintainer answered, verbatim: 「直接做C」 and then 「A+C」. ⛔ Not a claim: this repository's lanes own the fix; routing and grading are triage's.

**Consumer:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2073 item 1. HotCRM ships 10 reports, and 7 of them are reachable only by typing a URL. HotCRM is adding A now as its own interim; this card is the general fix every app needs.

## What happens (read on objectui `main` `09eadf4`)

- **The only door to a report is its own route.** `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` around line 1364 mounts `report/:reportName`. No route lists an app's reports: the routes around it are `dashboard/:name`, `page/:name`, `component/…`, `search`, and the system pages.
- **⌘K can only find reports that are in the navigation.** `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` around line 168 builds its report entries as `navOfType('report', 'reportName')`, which reads the active app's navigation items. A report that the app ships but does not put in its navigation is invisible to the palette.
- **Already fixed, so not part of this card:** HotCRM's walk found the report page's 「报表」 crumb going back to the app home. objectui#12273 removed that type crumb (`AppHeader.tsx` around line 694).
- **The console already has the data a list needs:** `AppHeader.tsx` resolves report labels from `metadata.reports` with `preferLocal(…, currentApp._packageId)`.

## Expected

1. **A report index under the app,** for example `/apps/APP/reports`. It lists the reports the app's packages ship, by their localized labels, each linking to `report/:reportName`.
   - It shows only the reports the viewer can run: a report whose base object the viewer cannot read is left out, rather than opening on a 403.
   - It is reachable from the app chrome without the app authoring anything. Its placement is this lane's design call.
2. **⌘K matches reports from the app's report metadata,** by label and name, under the same read-access rule. Today it matches navigation entries only.
3. **Pins:**
   - a report that is not in the navigation appears in the index and in ⌘K for a reader;
   - a report on an object the viewer cannot read appears in neither;
   - the existing nav-entry path is unchanged.

## After this lands

HotCRM may slim the navigation group it is adding now; objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2073 carries that follow-up. ⛔ Nothing in HotCRM waits on this card to ship.

## Dedupe

objectui issues searched for "console reports list page index all reports command palette search reports not in navigation breadcrumb". The hits are #12980 (the report getters' load cost, closed), #12601 (console home search, closed), #3047 (⌘K scope truncated to 8 nav objects, closed) and #578. None covers a report index or palette reach beyond the navigation.
